question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The mysterious aura of the old bookstore/ held an irresistibel alure, drawing book lovers from/far and wide to explore its hidden literary treasures.

options.text: held an irresistibel alure, drawing book lovers from
far and wide to explore its hidden literary treasures.
The mysterious aura of the old bookstore

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect spelling of the words "**irresistibel**" and "**alure**."
 
• The correct spelling should be "**irresistible**" and "**allure**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**held an irresistible allure, drawing book lovers from**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The mysterious aura of the old bookstore held an **irresistible allure**, drawing book lovers from far and wide to explore its hidden literary treasures."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 3: "The mysterious aura of the old bookstore," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "far and wide to explore its hidden literary treasures."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in option 1.
